title: MNQ history/live overlap mismatch, and the freshness day the data cannot cover
claim: The parquet is the wrong side, with high confidence and for a directional reason. The repair is a one-way write to shared history, applying it needs a broker connection that would contend with the running Stress slots, and it would fix one day only. Measured, tooled, handed over.

safety_statement.parquet_mtimes_unchanged: all five still carry their 2026-08-21 13:45-13:47 ET mtimes

part_a_measurement.columns_not_compared_why: the guard compares open, high, low, close in order and raises on the first that differs
part_a_measurement.direction: the feed's low is LOWER than the stored low - the only direction a partial minute's low can be wrong in
part_a_measurement.evidence_source: the window ledger's own slot_observed rows; no broker query was made

mechanism.consequence: the bar that was last in the file is never re-fetched, compared or rewritten; the dedupe at line 637 never sees a duplicate because new_only already excluded that timestamp
mechanism.systemic: the MECHANISM is systemic and deterministic - every 13:45 leaves a boundary bar. The observed CORRUPTION is one bar.

MES.evidence: the 10:00 ET Calm slot reached splice and failed on the column mismatch; the overlap check runs before the splice, over instruments in sorted order, so MES passed it

failed_measurement.what: whether partial boundary bars are systemic across history, measured offline from volume
failed_measurement.attempt_1: each bar vs its same-day neighbours, ratio < 0.6 - flagged 76-99 bars over 29-34 days, two or three a day in every instrument. That is the lunchtime lull
failed_measurement.attempt_2: each bar vs the SAME clock-minute across days, ratio < 0.35 - still 0.38-0.96 flags per day
failed_measurement.decisive: the bar we KNOW is wrong is NOT flagged (MNQ 13:45, ratio ~0.9), while a flagged one (MYM 2026-08-21 13:46, vol 15 vs usual 66, ratio 0.227, that file's last bar) is not known to be wrong
failed_measurement.conclusion: volume is not the discriminator; historical frequency is UNMEASURED. The only instrument that could measure it is a broker re-fetch of past windows compared bar by bar - which is what the repair tool does in dry run

part_b_freshness.mechanism: update_spy_csv fetches [fetch_from, today] from Polygon at 13:45 ET; the day's daily bar does not close until 16:00, so the CSV gains day D-1 at day D's pre-flight while required_data_through returns D from 13:45 onward
part_b_freshness.only_refresh_in_the_schedule: the 13:45 pre-flight (update_ibkr_daily then update_spy_csv) - confirmed by reading run_scheduler
part_b_freshness.grid_caveat: the one allow=True row in the wider grid (Fri 12:00) is an artefact of testing a past instant against today's file; on Friday at noon the CSV held Wednesday
part_b_freshness.consequence: shadow_live is a freshness-BINDING mode, so no Track 1 candidate can be admitted at any instant until this is resolved. Slots still observe and refuse by name
part_b_freshness.why_not: it needs either a second SPY refresh after the close or a requirement that asks for D-1 rather than D - both are decisions about what the route considers fresh

part_c_repair_decision.option_chosen: Option 2 - minimal safe repair utility, dry-run only, NOT applied
apply_requires: --expect <sha256 of the file as it is now>
guards: dry run by default - the only mode that runs without a second flag
--expect hash guard - stops a repair measured against one version landing on another
snapshot first, re-read and hash-checked before any write
bounded window - a disagreement outside it refuses the whole run
bounded count - more than --max-bars is a different problem
index unchanged - a repair replaces bars, never adds or removes one
verify by re-reading - a write that did not land is a failure, not an assumption
part_c_repair_decision.reuses: project_to_frozen_columns from 5Q-3, so the comparison is over the same columns the route joins on
why_not_applied: only `low` has been compared; close and volume on that bar are unmeasured because the guard stops at the first differing column
applying needs a broker fetch, which would open a second client beside the Stress slots on client id 89 - two clients on one id has already cost six entry slots
it fixes today only; tomorrow's 13:45 writes a fresh boundary bar (B-5R-F)
part_c_repair_decision.option_3_rejected: dropping the final parquet bar at runtime changes the frame every sleeve reads, on every slot, to work around one bar - and would silently change what a frozen-window backtest computes on. The guard is right, the data is wrong, the data is what should move
part_c_repair_decision.promotion_to_production: deferred - the tool earns a place in global_index/ only once B-5R-F is decided, since the right answer may be that the appender stops creating the problem

blockers_before_5r.what: the 13:45 pre-flight marks a day true before that day's SPY close exists, so the regime CSV is permanently one business day behind the freshness requirement
blockers_before_5r.impact: no candidate can be admitted at any instant

blockers_before_5r.impact: refuses every Stress slot; MNQ is in the swing basket too
blockers_before_5r.state: open - measured, tool ready, not applied

blockers_before_5r.impact: B-5R-D is one instance of it; a repair fixes one day

blockers_before_5r.what: NKD after 2026-11-01: 12 of 22 ET slots outside the Tokyo decision band

widen the overlap guard - it is the only thing that noticed
restart the scheduler or the backend - no production module changed in this stage
